newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end higher on Handelsbanken's bid.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end higher on Handelsbanken's bid.

text.p: Swedish shares were lifted by a bank sector rally on Thursday, triggered by banking group Handelsbanken's 23 billion crown bid for mortgage bank Stadshypotek.
The general index rose 0.11 percent to 2,284.39 in turnover of 3.90 billion crowns.
"The market took off after Handelsbanken's and Stadshypotek's shares resumed trading," a broker said.
Stadshypotek rose six crowns to 188 crowns, while Handelsbanken jumped 7.5 crowns to 196 crowns. The shares were suspended ahead of Handelsbanken's announcement at 1500 GMT.
The two shares' gains lifted the bank and insurance sector 2.63 percent, thereby becoming the day's winner.
But on the other end of the stick was the forestry sector, which plummeted 1.88 percent on higher-than-expected Norscan figures, dealers said.
Earlier in the day, non-traded forestry company Sodra announced preliminary Norscan figures, which showed an increase in November by more than 185,000 tonnes from October.
SCA plunged five crowns to 140.5 crowns, while MoDo dropped 4.5 crowns to 186.5 crowns and Stora fell 1.5 crowns to 91.5 crowns.
